appLock.body: Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID, your fingerprint or the device's own lock. Nothing leaves this device.
appLock.failed: That didn't unlock it. Try again.
appLock.failedMany: Still locked after three tries. Your notes stay hidden until the device's check passes.
appLock.recover.done: Unlocked with the recovery code. The app lock is off now: turn it on again to make a new key and a new code.
appLock.recover.label: Recovery code
appLock.recover.none: This lock has no recovery code (it was turned on before there were codes). Unlock with the device's check.
appLock.recover.show.body: If this device's check stops working (Windows Hello reset, a new fingerprint, a cleared browser), this code unlocks Lumen once. Write it down and keep it away from this device. It is shown only now: {code}
appLock.recover.show.title: Your app lock recovery code
appLock.recover.wait: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
appLock.title: Lumen is locked
